observations: Wall-mounted salon hair dryer unit with a hood/air chamber and a long nozzle/duct.
Front control panel has two knobs/switches and a small indicator light area.
Brand text on the front label appears to read “MANGO” (photo 0/1/2/3).
No visible damage; unit looks clean and intact in the photos.
Photos show the unit installed on a wall bracket; power cable/plug details are not clearly shown.

claims.claim: Mango wall hair dryer for salons.
claims.evidence: Brand “MANGO” is visible on the front label in photo 0/1/2/3, and the unit is clearly a wall-mounted salon-style hair dryer.
No photo evidence (serial/date/usage meter) confirms the duration of use.
Photos show no obvious cracks or missing parts, but condition like heating performance, airflow, and electrical safety cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Heating element may be weak/faulty or airflow may be poor (photos can’t confirm performance).
risks.proof: A short video of the dryer running with the heat on (show indicator light), plus a thermometer reading or at least a clear “hot air” demonstration.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to heat strongly (worst case: treat as needing service/possible performance issue).

risks.risk: Electrical safety issues (wiring, plug, earth/grounding, switch faults).
risks.proof: Photo of the plug/cord and a quick test: power-on with no sparking + seller shows the switch/controls working; ideally an electrician’s test report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical function not verified (worst case: assume it may require basic electrical checks).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or mounting hardware (bracket/bolts) needed for installation.
risks.proof: Photos of everything included: wall bracket, all screws/bolts, and the full power cord/plug end.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as buyer may need to source missing mounting parts.

risks.risk: Model/ratings mismatch (voltage/power rating) affecting compatibility in Abuja.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rating plate/label (voltage, wattage, frequency) on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard/unknown ratings (worst case: assume it may not match local requirements without adjustment).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating plate/label (voltage/wattage/model number).
Video showing it switched on and heating/airflow working (controls demonstrated).
Photo of the plug/cord end and any visible wiring/earth connection.
Photo of all included mounting hardware (bracket, bolts/screws) and what exactly comes with the unit.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a Mango wall-mounted salon hair dryer, but key factors that determine a safe resale price in Abuja—heating performance, electrical safety, and exact voltage/model—are not verifiable from the images alone.
